_meta.note: Final candidate config; B1.1 NOT frozen until the freeze-manifest gate. Does NOT authorize generation.
_meta.crux: R_deranged is the crux; contrastivity is necessary but not sufficient.

A.description: target word's own varṇa-derived binding/liberating bridge (real mapping)
A.construction_rule: G2P->varṇa sequence of the target word; compose its bridge phrases in order (see composition_policy). contrast_boundary is metadata only and is NEVER rendered.

composition_policy.g2p_source: varna_lens.phonemes_cmudict — REAL G2P->varṇa routing ONLY (routing code, NOT a meaning source)
composition_policy.meaning_source: b1_1 bridge pool binding_bridge/liberating_bridge ONLY (derived from b1_1_experimental_contrastive_lexicon_draft.json); NEVER the varna_lens meaning lexicon
composition_policy.pole_rule: vowel-attachment (varna_lens read_op rule): word-first consonant -> binding; consonant with a vowel immediately after (onset) -> liberating; bare consonant (word-final / pre-consonant) -> binding; doubled consonant: 1st occurrence -> liberating, 2nd -> binding
composition_policy.phrase_selected: binding_bridge for a binding pole, liberating_bridge for a liberating pole
composition_policy.cap: none (all consonant varṇas of the word)

D.construction_rule: plain dictionary meaning of the target word; must NOT leak the A mapping

S.construction_rule: retain the word's varṇa set; break assignment/order via seeded scramble (arm_construction_seed)

R_same.description: random bridge from the same revised pool
R_same.construction_rule: sample bridge phrases from the same 68-phrase pool, NOT the target's own mapping; matched count/length/style; seed r_same_sample_seed

R_deranged.description: another word's REAL A mapping assigned to the wrong word (CRUX)
R_deranged.construction_rule: fixed seeded derangement pi over the word list (pi(w)!=w); word w receives the real A mapping of pi(w); mapping quality maximal, only word->mapping fit broken; seed r_deranged_assignment_seed

R_domain.description: fluent symbolic mapping from a deliberately mismatched domain
R_domain.construction_rule: sample a coherent mapping from a domain in the word's forbidden-domain list; same length/grammar/style; seed r_domain_assignment_seed

C.construction_rule: surface facts / style-matched filler; must NOT leak the A mapping

contrast_boundary_policy.reason: contrast_boundary names other varṇas (e.g. 'not object-renunciation (Gha)') and would leak the mapping; it is retained for traceability only and MUST NOT enter any conditioning/prompt.
contrast_boundary_policy.runner_enforcement: run_b1_1_generation.py composes A/S from binding_bridge/liberating_bridge only; it never reads contrast_boundary into conditioning.

rules.no_target_self: R_same and R_deranged must NEVER use the target word's own mapping
rules.same_pool: R_same draws only from the revised 68-phrase bridge pool
rules.deranged_real_mapping_from_other_word: R_deranged uses a REAL A mapping from a different word (not synthetic, not ugly)
rules.domain_mismatch: R_domain uses a coherent but domain-mismatched mapping; forbidden/allowed domain lists per word
rules.style_length_normalization: all arms comparable in length/style; R controls strong and fluent, never ugly or nonsense
rules.exclusion_rules: none beyond the pre-registered word/task set

r_domain_policy.assignment_rule: for each target item, deterministically assign one MISMATCHED bucket (different from the word's native semantic bucket) via r_domain_assignment_seed; sample a fluent, same-style symbolic mapping from that bucket
r_domain_policy.no_target_self: R_domain never uses the target word's own B1.1 bridge or its native bucket
r_domain_policy.determinism: seeded by r_domain_assignment_seed (b1_1_seeds_config.json); independent of generation results; no model judgment
r_domain_policy.style_parity: same symbolic richness / length / grammar as A; never ugly, nonsense, or obviously weaker than A
r_domain_policy.per_word_expansion: the native-bucket-per-word map is expanded at arm-builder time against the FROZEN B1.1 word list; policy is defined at bucket level now and does not fabricate an unknown final word list
r_domain_policy.validation_rule: every R_domain assignment must come from a bucket != the target word's native bucket
r_domain_policy.bucket_keyword_map_note: 'dharma' here is a bucketing KEYWORD used only to sort English bridge text into a domain; it is NOT rendered into any prompt (bridge phrases contain no Sanskrit after the Śa fix).
r_domain_policy.bridge_bucket_rule: each of the 68 bridge phrases is assigned to the bucket whose keyword list it matches most (ties -> first bucket in the fixed bucket order).
r_domain_policy.native_bucket_rule: a target word's native bucket = the bucket of its own A-composition text (same bridge_bucket_rule).
r_domain_policy.mismatched_bucket_rule: deterministically pick a bucket != native (and non-empty) via r_domain_assignment_seed keyed on the word; sample count-matched bridge phrases from it.
r_domain_policy.assignments_artifact: b1_1_r_domain_assignments.json (persisted per-word native/mismatched buckets; deterministically reproducible from this frozen policy + frozen seeds + frozen word pool)
r_domain_policy.config_is_authoritative: run_b1_1_generation.py loads bucket_keyword_map + bucket order from THIS frozen config; the bucketing is no longer a runner-internal heuristic.
r_domain_policy.length_parity_rule: accumulate distinct phrases from the chosen mismatched bucket until >= n phrases AND >= 0.6x the target word's A-composition length; prefer a mismatched bucket whose total text can reach that length, so R_domain is never obviously weaker/shorter than A.
r_domain_policy.empty_bucket_note: a bucket may hold 0 phrases (e.g. speech/communication under the current keyword map); empty buckets are never chosen as the mismatched bucket and never fabricated.
